websiteEvidence.evidence: Official Phase-3 reserve and wrapping instructions, preferred over historic yield-oriented landing page. Refers to direct wrapping at the exact Ethereum token and separate wrap/bridge resources; availability of those frontends was not tested.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official legacy token page explicitly maps Ethereum wUSDM to this address; current official Phase-3 reserve guide independently links same token. Proxy deployment constructor initializes USDM/owner and refers to an INITIAL implementation different from source-service/explorer-reported current implementation. Review uses reported current implementation 0x616B7f7D7FAAF87beaA35c5759425cCCf4c9DB0c. No RPC or fresh storage/runtime check.

abiEvidence.officialComparison: Only difference against final official pinned wUSDM.sol is deployed uint256[49] __gap versus official uint256[48] __gap. No byte-for-byte equality claim. Official audit explicitly discloses deployment without N-01 storage-gap change; reviewed deployed source is authoritative. Future upgrades must preserve actual deployed layout. No whole-repository/dependency-byte identity claim.
abiEvidence.evidence: Full exact-implementation ABI retained unchanged (67 entries, 48 functions); selected fragments come directly from it, not generic ERC-4626 or historic initial implementation. Proxy ABI retained separately (no function entries). Exact-chain/address source-service labels are recorded as reported, not fresh bytecode/runtime or financial guarantees.

lifecycle.evidence: Official notice disables issuer minting, ends rewards after 30-day Phase 1 and closes primary market at Phase 3 (2025-08-22 per legal terms/site). Phase-3 reserve guide states reserves moved as USDC into Ethereum Uniswap v4 wUSDM:USDC pool 0xd3d6e5a73a27081ddd95955f5ae2efbb063013e736f79431c3a31f2817898a35 and explicitly explains wrapping existing USDM before swapping. Therefore all four ordinary wrapper methods remain selected for conversion/redemption-oriented handling, not a renewed savings product; an exit-only unwrap claim would omit the officially documented wrap-to-USDC exit path. USDM minting disabled economically is not a code-level unconditional revert in ERC-4626 mint(). No live pool/balances/issuer-role state verified.

sourceSemantics.assetBinding: Proxy constructor data initializes both wUSDM.USDM and ERC4626._asset to 0x59D9356E565Ab3A36dD77763Fc0d87fEaf85508C. Official Ethereum USDM mapping corroborates. Implementation has no ordinary asset setter; proxy upgrades can change logic/storage. USDM is 18 decimals; wUSDM inherits cached underlying decimals with zero offset.
sourceSemantics.wrapperFlow: ERC4626 deposit/mint first SafeERC20.transferFrom initialized USDM from caller to proxy, then mint receiver shares. withdraw/redeem check max against owner shares, spend share allowance only when caller != owner, burn owner shares then SafeERC20.transfer underlying to receiver. No arbitrary target/calldata, user-defined callback, native payment, router or nested executor is accepted. Separate underlying-token calls are fixed by initialization.
sourceSemantics.accessAndPause: wUSDM hook actually checks only USDM.isBlocked(from), not to despite doc-comment wording. On burns from=owner; on mints from=zero address. paused() = underlying paused OR local pause. Underlying transfer sender blocklist adds caller check when wrapping and proxy check when unwrapping; recipient is not checked. Neither local hook checks msg.sender independently on delegated unwrap. Mint/burn reject zero receiver/owner through ERC20; underlying transfer rejects zero receiver. Max functions and previews do not incorporate pause/blocklist/allowance.
sourceSemantics.rounding: OZ 4.9 deployed dependency: shares=assets*(totalSupply+1)/(totalAssets+1), assets=shares*(totalAssets+1)/(totalSupply+1), decimalsOffset=0. deposit/redeem round down, mint/withdraw round up; convert getters round down. totalAssets is USDM.balanceOf(proxy), not USDC collateral. Direct donations and underlying multiplier/rebase changes affect rate; virtual shares/assets mitigate but do not prove manipulation immunity. No minimum shares/assets, maximum input shares/assets or deadline. Positive small deposit/redeem can return zero.

underlying.evidence: Reviewed exact source-service-reported USDM implementation dependency. USDM.balanceOf=internalShares*rewardMultiplier/1e18; token transfer converts nominal assets to internal shares with floor(amount*1e18/rewardMultiplier), then moves those shares. Actual recipient delta can differ from nominal transfer/event/preview values; wrapper does not measure incoming/outgoing delta. Sender-only blocklist and USDM pause apply; admin may set multiplier >=1e18 (including decreases), oracle may increase, privileged roles manage mint/burn/blocklist/pause/upgrades. Economic no-new-mint/no-reward announcement is not evidence of current role revocation, fixed multiplier, or immutable underlying. No token capability admitted.

sourceSemantics.proxyAndAudit: ERC1967Proxy fallback delegates to implementation from EIP-1967 slot. UUPS upgrades are onlyProxy + UPGRADE_ROLE; role administrators may grant/revoke permissions. Source constructor disables implementation initializers; initialization sets proxy owner DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Audit final repository gap is 48 slots, deployed is 49; report says omitting N-01 is not a security risk only while layout is maintained on future upgrades. Audit is historical, not current upgrade, financial or runtime assurance.
sourceSemantics.exclusions: All 30 read-only getters/quotes/interface helpers, 5 generic approval/transfer methods, permit, initialization, role changes, pause/unpause and upgrades excluded individually. Proxy constructor/events/fallback/receive create no capability. No USDC swap, bridge or issuer redemption is added.
sourceSemantics.legal: Phase-3 terms effective 2025-08-22 discontinue primary platform/accounts and issuer redemption/backing/liquidity guarantees, retain U.S.-person/restricted-jurisdiction prohibitions and user compliance obligations. Docs have inconsistent historic phase-date text and broad backing language; the explicit Phase-3 legal effective date and current reserve methodology are recorded without claiming backing adequacy or legal eligibility.

selectedFunctions.label: Mountain wUSDM deposit
warnings: Mountain USDM is in Phase-3 wind-down effective 2025-08-22: issuer primary issuance/redemption and accounts are discontinued, rewards are zero, and former Treasury/$1 redemption claims no longer apply. Official reserves documentation describes a separate Ethereum Uniswap v4 wUSDM/USDC pool; no pool liquidity, backing, peg, yield or execution guarantee is made.

deposit/mint only wrap existing USDM into wUSDM and are included because official Phase-3 instructions require wrapping before some USDC exit routes. withdraw/redeem return USDM, not USDC or fiat. This admission does not include swaps, bridges, issuer mint/burn, generic transfers, approvals, permits or administration, and does not prove a complete redemption workflow.

Underlying initialized as Ethereum USDM 0x59D9356E565Ab3A36dD77763Fc0d87fEaf85508C; assets use USDM units (18 decimals), shares use wUSDM units. Wrapping requires caller USDM balance and allowance to the proxy. Unwrapping burns owner wUSDM; caller other than owner spends owner-to-caller wUSDM allowance. Intended nonzero receiver and zero native value required.

Wrapper transfer/mint/burn hook checks underlying USDM.isBlocked(from), not recipient: burns check owner, mints check zero address. USDM transfers additionally check underlying sender (caller for wrapping, proxy for unwrapping). Either wrapper or underlying pause reverts actions; max/preview reads do not ensure eligibility or success. Tokens received by blocked addresses can become inaccessible.

ERC-4626 conversions use virtual +1 asset/+1 share, zero decimals offset and current wrapper USDM balance. Deposit shares/redeem assets round down; mint assets/withdraw shares round up. Positive small deposits or redemptions may yield zero output. Donation/rebase/multiplier changes affect conversions; no caller-set minimum output, maximum input or deadline exists.

Reviewed underlying USDM transfer accounting floors conversion to internal shares; returned/events/preview amounts are nominal and need not equal recipient balance delta. SafeERC20 checks call success/optional boolean, not exact received balances. Underlying administrator can change rewardMultiplier, block senders, pause and manage upgrade roles despite the economic wind-down.

Calls target the exact proxy, not implementation. Sourcify and explorer report implementation 0x616B7f7D7FAAF87beaA35c5759425cCCf4c9DB0c; service exact_match labels and source review are not fresh runtime/storage/role/implementation-persistence attestation. Deployed wrapper retains 49-slot storage gap versus 48 in pinned final official source; historical audit explicitly notes this difference and future-upgrade storage-layout constraint.

Phase-3 terms retain U.S.-person and restricted-jurisdiction prohibitions. Catalog metadata does not establish legal eligibility or bypass independent grants, pause checks, canonical ABI/value validation, recipient/destination or execution controls.
